title: Property Maintenance evidence tiles corrected
details: Combined Property Maintenance evidence prompts are now split into separate tiles on the job screen itself
Tiling repairs now shows four tiles on the same screen: Tiling repair, Setting out, Preparation and Cutting tiles
Each tile opens one photo-or-video evidence capture instead of hiding several evidence pieces inside one tile
Plaster, flooring, drainage, doors and windows, masonry, roofing, fencing, groundwork and decorating use the same tile-splitting rule where their prompt contains distinct evidence pieces
Existing evidence from the earlier staged version is migrated onto the matching separate tile where possible
summary: Evia v135 puts each Property Maintenance evidence item on its own tile.
changes: Split multi-part ST0171 opportunities into separate job-screen tiles
Kept one photo or video capture per tile
Preserved the guided photo and video evidence flow
Migrated saved staged evidence to the matching new opportunity
Moved the offline shell to v135
